summary: For netconf through a jump host, set ansible_netconf_ssh_config, ANSIBLE_NETCONF_SSH_CONFIG or ssh_config under netconf_connection to True (use ~/.ssh/config) or a custom ssh config path.
questions: How do I use a jump host with NETCONF?
Can the netconf connection read my ~/.ssh/config?

answer_card.title: Jump host with NETCONF
answer_card.answer_md:
Set any of:
- `ansible_netconf_ssh_config: True` (or a path)
- `ANSIBLE_NETCONF_SSH_CONFIG=True` (or a path)
- `ssh_config = 1` (or a path) under `[netconf_connection]` in ansible.cfg

`1`/True reads ProxyCommand and other settings from `~/.ssh/config`; a path reads that file instead.
